paragraphs: Core & Main, Inc. ("Core & Main" and collectively with its subsidiaries, the "Company," "we," "our" or "us") is a holding company and its primary material assets are its direct and indirect ownership interest in Core & Main Holdings, LP, a Delaware limited partnership ("Holdings"), and deferred tax assets associated with this ownership. Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor dedicated to advancing reliable infrastructure with local service, nationwide. With a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products, and related services, we provide solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets. Our specialty products and services are used primarily in the maintenance, repair, replacement and new construction of water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection infrastructure. We are one of only two national distributors operating across large and highly fragmented markets, which we estimate to represent approximately $44 billion in annual sales.

As of February 1, 2026, we had a network of over 370 branch locations across the United States ("U.S.") and Canada, which serve as a critical link between more than 5,000 suppliers and a diverse and long-standing base of over 60,000 customers. Our sales reach, technical product knowledge, broad product portfolio, customer service, project planning and delivery capabilities, customer service and ability to provide local expertise, nationwide, make us a critical partner to both our customers and suppliers.

We offer a comprehensive portfolio of more than 225,000 products covering a full spectrum of specialized solutions to address aging water infrastructure, including pipes, valves & fittings, storm drainage products, fire protection products and smart metering products. Our products are generally unique to our industry and must meet municipal, state and federal specifications and engineering standards.

We have a balanced mix of sales across product categories, end markets and construction sectors. We estimate we derived approximately 44% of our net sales for the fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 ("fiscal 2025") from the municipal end market, 38% from the non-residential end market and 18% from the residential end market. Furthermore, we estimate we had a near-equal mix of sales related to construction on new projects and existing repair and replacement projects in fiscal 2025.

Our mission is to deliver essential infrastructure products and solutions to communities for water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection needs. We succeed by investing in our people to know their industries, products and customers, connecting local experts within our national network to deliver anytime, anywhere. We advance the future of water infrastructure with trusted expertise, innovative solutions, and reliable products and service.

Our first legacy distribution company dates back to 1874, and over the years, the Company has grown organically and through a series of mergers and acquisitions. In 2005, The Home Depot acquired National Waterworks Holdings and subsequently merged it with Hughes Supply Inc. to establish one of the leading waterworks distributors in the U.S. Under The Home Depot's ownership, we became HD Supply Waterworks and further expanded our geographic footprint. In 2007, a group of private equity investors acquired HD Supply from The Home Depot and subsequently executed an initial public offering in 2013. In August 2017, HD Supply Waterworks was acquired by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, LLC ("CD&R") from HD Supply and was subsequently rebranded as Core & Main. On July 27, 2021, we completed our initial public offering of Class A common stock (the "IPO"). Since the IPO, we completed a series of secondary public offerings of shares of Class A common stock on behalf of the CD&R Investors (as defined below under Item 1A. "Risk Factors"), and as of January 25, 2024, the CD&R Investors no longer held any shares of our Class A common stock or our Class B common stock.
We have diversified exposure across three primary end markets: (i) municipal; (ii) non-residential; and (iii) residential.

Based on management's estimates, we believe that our addressable market in the U.S. and Canada for the distribution of water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products, and related services, represented approximately $44 billion in sales in fiscal 2025. Growth in our industry is driven by a broad array of factors, including municipal water infrastructure spending, water and wastewater utility rates, interest rates, housing starts, commercial construction, population growth and other demographic trends.

We estimate that approximately 44% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 were to contractors and municipalities for municipal projects, including the repair, replacement, upgrade and new construction of water and wastewater supply, filtration, storage and distribution systems. Municipalities establish local product specifications based on regulatory requirements and engineering standards. Given our extensive geographic footprint and knowledge of products and local municipal specifications, we believe we are well-equipped to anticipate and serve the needs of municipalities, private water companies and underground utility contractors who require a national reach and an extensive product offering.

Municipal demand has exhibited steady growth over the long term due to the critical need to replace aged water infrastructure. Funding for municipal projects is derived from a variety of sources, including local utility rate revenues, municipal bonds, and state revolving fund programs administered by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Historically, the majority of funding has been generated at the state and local level, which we believe contributes to the stability of the municipal end market across economic cycles. In November 2021, the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act ("IIJA") was signed into U.S. law, which included an allocation of $55 billion to invest in water infrastructure across the U.S., the majority of which we believe has yet to be realized. We believe these dynamics create the backdrop for a favorable funding environment and accelerated investment in projects that will benefit our business.

We estimate that approximately 38% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 were directly related to water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection systems supporting non-residential construction activity, including commercial, industrial, institutional, warehousing, multi-family housing, and highway and street projects. Our products are often installed while breaking ground on new lot development during the initial construction phase, though some products are used during new construction and repair and replace activities. Our fire protection products are typically installed at later stages of construction projects compared to most of our other products, and they exhibit less seasonal patterns since they are generally installed indoors and are therefore less impacted by weather conditions.

Demand across the non-residential end market has historically lagged residential construction activity as commercial development is necessary to support new housing development. Over the long term, we expect, but cannot provide any assurance that, non-residential construction activity to increase as suburban and rural communities expand, and demand for our products and services increases.

We estimate that approximately 18% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 were directly related to new land and lot development to support single-family housing, where our products are installed during the early stages of development prior to vertical home construction. Over the long-term, residential construction activity is expected to grow as a result of population growth, low housing inventory and demographic population shifts. The current under-build of housing in the U.S. compared with household formations implies significant pent-up demand and continued growth going forward.

Our business and the market for our products and services generally are subject to slowdowns in municipal infrastructure spending which may result in reduced net sales.
We may lose business to competitors through the competitive bidding process.
We are subject to price fluctuations in our product costs.
We are subject to inventory management risks. Insufficient inventory may result in lost sales opportunities or delayed revenue, while excess inventory may negatively impact our gross margin.
Acquisitions and other strategic transactions involve a number of inherent risks, any of which could result in the benefits anticipated not being realized.

Any difficulties with, or interruptions of, our fabrication services could delay our output of products and harm our relationships with our customers.

paragraphs: The following information should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following discussion may contain forward-looking statements that reflect our plans, estimates and beliefs. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a number of important factors, particularly those described under the caption "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

Core & Main, Inc. ("Core & Main" and collectively with its subsidiaries, the "Company") is a leading specialty distributor dedicated to advancing reliable infrastructure with local service, nationwide. With a focus on water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection products, and related services, we provide solutions to municipalities, private water companies and professional contractors across municipal, non-residential and residential end markets. Our specialty products and services are used primarily in the maintenance, repair, replacement and new construction of water, wastewater, storm drainage and fire protection infrastructure. We reach customers through a network of over 370 branches across the United States ("U.S.") and Canada. Our products include pipes, valves, fittings, storm drainage products, fire protection products, meter products and other products. We complement our core products through additional offerings, including smart meter systems, fusible high-density polyethylene ("fusible HDPE ") piping solutions, specifically engineered treatment plant products, geosynthetics and erosion control products. The Company's services and capabilities allow for integration with customers and form part of their sourcing and procurement function.

The Company is a holding company that indirectly owns Core & Main LP through its ownership interest in Core & Main Holdings, LP ("Holdings"). Core & Main's primary material assets are its direct and indirect ownership interest in Holdings and deferred tax assets associated with such ownership. The consolidated financial information of Core & Main presented herein, including the accompanying audited consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, includes the consolidated financial information of Holdings and its subsidiaries. The limited partner interests of Holdings ("Partnership Interests") not held by Core & Main are reflected as non-controlling interests in the condensed consolidated financial statements.

Our fiscal year is a 52- or 53-week period ending on the Sunday nearest to January 31st. Quarters within the fiscal year include 13-week periods, unless a fiscal year includes a 53rd week, in which case the fourth quarter of the fiscal year will be a 14-week period. The fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 ("fiscal 2025") included 52 weeks, the fiscal year ended February 2, 2025 ("fiscal 2024") included 53 weeks and the fiscal year ended January 28, 2024 ("fiscal 2023") included 52 weeks. The next fiscal year ending January 31, 2027 ("fiscal 2026") will include 52 weeks.

On December 1, 2025, the Company's board of directors authorized an increase of $500 million to the Company's share repurchase program (the "Repurchase Program"), bringing the total authorization to $1 billion. Shares repurchased under the Repurchase Program are retired immediately and are accounted for as a decrease to stockholders' equity. During fiscal 2025, the Company repurchased 3,173,594 shares of Class A common stock for a total of $155 million through open market transactions.

On February 9, 2024, Core & Main LP amended the terms of the Senior ABL Credit Facility (as defined in Note 6 to the audited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K) in order to extend the maturity from July 27, 2026 to February 9, 2029.

On February 9, 2024, Core & Main LP entered into a $750 million senior term loan, which matures on February 9, 2031 (the "2031 Senior Term Loan"). Proceeds of the 2031 Senior Term Loan were used to, among other things, (a) repay total outstanding borrowings under the Senior ABL Credit Facility, (b) invest in organic growth and productivity initiatives, M&A, share repurchases or other initiatives aligned with Core & Main's capital allocation strategy and (c) pay related fees, premiums and expenses.

On February 12, 2024, Core & Main LP entered into an interest rate swap that has a starting notional amount of $750 million that increases to $1,500 million on July 27, 2026 through the instrument maturity on July 27, 2028. The instrument is intended to reduce the Company's exposure to variable interest rates under the senior term loan facilities.

On May 21, 2024, Core & Main LP amended the terms of the $1,500 million senior term loan (as amended, the "2028 Senior Term Loan"), in order to reduce the effective applicable margin from 2.60% to 2.00%.

On December 17, 2024, Core & Main LP amended the terms of the 2031 Senior Term Loan, in order to increase the principal balance by $200 million to $944 million with the proceeds utilized to repay outstanding borrowings under the 2028 Senior Term Loan. In addition, the amendment reduced the effective applicable margin from 2.25% to 2.00%.

Refer to Note 6 to the audited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further discussion of the amendment to the Senior ABL Credit Facility, the 2028 Senior Term Loan, the 2031 Senior Term Loan and the interest rate swap.

On June 12, 2024, the Company's board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to $500 million of the Company's Class A common stock under the Repurchase Program. During fiscal 2024, the Company repurchased 3,974,820 shares of Class A common stock for a total of $176 million through open market transactions.

During fiscal 2023, the Company repurchased from certain selling stockholders affiliated with CD&R 45,000,000 total Class A common stock and Partnership Interests for total consideration of $1,344 million. Refer to Note 1 to the audited consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further discussion of the share repurchase transactions completed in fiscal 2023.

During fiscal 2023, certain shareholders affiliated with CD&R exchanged 43,406,925 Partnership Interests and shares of Class B common stock, which were retired, for a corresponding number of shares of Class A common stock.

paragraphs: Core & Main, Inc. ("Core & Main" and collectively with its subsidiaries, the "Company," "we," "our" or "us") 是一家控股公司，其主要資產為直接及間接持有 Core & Main Holdings, LP，一間 Delaware 有限合夥企業 ("Holdings") 的股權，以及與此股權相關的遞延所得稅資產。Core & Main 是一家專注於提升可靠基礎設施與本地服務的專業經銷商，服務範圍遍及全美。我們專注於水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護產品與相關服務，為地方政府、私人水公司及專業承包商提供解決方案，應用於水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護基礎設施的維護、修理、更換及新建工程。我們是僅有的兩家全國性經銷商之一，經營範圍涵蓋大型且高度分散的市場，我們估計這些市場年銷售額約為 440 億美元。
截至 2026 年 2 月 1 日，我們在美國 ("U.S.") 和加拿大擁有超過 370 個分支據點，作為連接超過 5,000 家供應商與多元且長期的逾 60,000 家客戶的關鍵橋樑。我們的銷售網路、技術產品知識、廣泛的產品組合、客戶服務、項目規劃與交付能力、客戶服務及提供全國範圍的本地專業知識，使我們成為客戶與供應商的重要合作夥伴。
我們提供涵蓋超過 225,000 種產品的完整產品組合，提供全方位的專業解決方案，以應對老化的水基礎設施，包括管路、閥門與配件、暴雨排水產品、消防保護產品及智慧計量產品。我們的產品通常為產業獨有，必須符合地方政府、州政府及聯邦政府的規範與工程標準。
我們的銷售分佈於各產品類別、終端市場及建設產業之間，我們估計在截至 2026 年 2 月 1 日的財務年度 ("財務 2025")，約有 44% 的淨銷售額來自終端市場，38% 來自非住宅終端市場，18% 來自住宅終端市場。此外，我們估計在財務 2025 年，銷售與新建項目及現有維修與更換項目之間的銷售比例接近相等。
我們的使命是為社區提供水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護所需的基礎設施產品與解決方案。我們的成功來自於投資於員工，使其瞭解其產業、產品與客戶，並透過我們的全國網路內的本地專家，隨時隨地提供服務。我們以受信任的專業知識、創新解決方案及可靠產品與服務，推動水基礎設施的未來。

我們的首個歷史經銷商可追溯至 1874 年，多年來，本公司透過內部成長及一系列合併與收購持續擴張。2005 年，The Home Depot 收購 National Waterworks Holdings，並隨後與 Hughes Supply Inc. 合併，建立美國領先的水工經銷商之一。在 The Home Depot 的擁有下，我們成為 HD Supply Waterworks，並進一步擴展地理範圍。2007 年，一羣私人股權投資者從 The Home Depot 收購 HD Supply，並於 2013 年執行首次公開發行。2017 年 8 月，HD Supply Waterworks 從 HD Supply 收購，並重新品牌為 Core & Main。2021 年 7 月 27 日，我們完成 Class A 普通股的首次公開發行 ("IPO")。自 IPO 以來，我們為 CD&R 投資者 (如下文 Item 1A. "風險因素" 所定義) 完成一系列二次公開發行，截至 2024 年 1 月 25 日，CD&R 投資者不再持有本公司 Class A 普通股或 Class B 普通股。
我們在三個主要終端市場擁有分散的業務：(i) 地方政府；(ii) 非住宅；(iii) 住宅。
根據管理層的估計，我們認為在美國和加拿大，水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護產品與相關服務的經銷市場，於財務 2025 年代表約 440 億美元的銷售額。我們產業的成長受到多種因素驅動，包括地方政府水基礎設施支出、水與污水公用事業費用、利率、住宅開工數、商業建設、人口成長及其他人口趨勢。
我們估計，我們在財務年度2025的淨銷售額約有44%是銷售給承包商與地方政府，用於市政工程，包括水與廢水供應、過濾、儲存與分配系統的修復、更換、升級與新建工程。地方政府根據法規要求與工程標準建立當地產品規格。基於我們廣泛的地理覆蓋範圍與對產品及當地市政規格的瞭解，我們認為我們非常適合預測並服務需要全國性覆蓋與廣泛產品線的地方政府、私人水公司與地下設施承包商的需求。

由於更換老舊水基礎設施的迫切需求，市政需求在長遠來看已呈現穩定成長。市政工程的資金來源包括地方公用設施費用收入、市政債券，以及由美國環境保護局管理的州轉輪基金計畫。歷史資料顯示，資金主要來自州與地方層級，我們認為這有助於在經濟週期中維持市政終端市場的穩定性。2021年11月，美國通過了《基礎建設投資與就業法案》（"IIJA"），其中包含550億美元用於美國的水基礎設施投資，我們認為其中絕大部分尚未實現。我們認為這些因素為有利的資金環境與加速投資奠定了基礎，將有利於我們的業務。
我們估計，我們在財務年度2025的淨銷售額約有38%與支持非住宅建設活動的水、廢水、暴雨排水與消防保護系統直接相關，包括商業、工業、機構、倉儲、多戶住宅與公路與街道工程。我們的產品通常在新地塊開發開始時安裝，雖然有些產品會在新建與修復更換活動中使用。我們的消防保護產品通常在建設項目較後階段安裝，與我們的其他產品相比，其季節性較低，因為這些產品通常在室內安裝，因此較不受天氣條件影響。
非住宅終端市場的需求歷史來看通常落後住宅建設活動，因為商業開發是支持新住宅開發的必要條件。長期來看，我們預期，但無法提供任何保證，非住宅建設活動將增加，因郊區與鄉村社區擴張，對我們產品與服務的需求將增加。
我們估計，我們在財務年度2025的淨銷售額約有18%與支持單戶住宅的新型土地與地塊開發直接相關，其中我們的產品在開發初期階段安裝，於垂直住宅建設前。長期來看，住宅建設活動預期將成長，因人口成長、低住房庫存量與人口結構變遷。美國目前的住房建設與家庭形成之間的落後，意味著有大量未被滿足的需求，並預期持續成長。

paragraphs: 下列資訊應與本年度報告表10-K所包含之合併財務報表一併閱讀。下列討論可能包含向前看的陳述，反映本公司之計畫、預估與信念。本公司實際結果可能與下列及本年度報告表10-K其他部分所討論者有重大差異，原因包括多項重要因素，特別是那些在「向前看陳述之警示說明」標題下所描述者。

Core & Main, Inc. ("Core & Main" 以及與其子公司合稱為 "本公司") 是一家領導的專業經銷商，致力於透過本地服務，全國範圍內推進可靠基礎設施。以水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護產品與相關服務為重點，本公司為地方政府、私人水公司及專業承包商提供解決方案，覆蓋地方政府、非住宅及住宅終端市場。本公司之專業產品與服務主要用於水、污水、暴雨排水及消防保護基礎設施之維護、修復、更換及新建工程。本公司透過美國 ("U.S.") 與加拿大逾 370 個門市所組成之網路接觸客戶。本公司產品包括管路、閥門、接頭、暴雨排水產品、消防保護產品、計量產品及其他產品。本公司透過額外產品與服務補強核心產品，包括智慧計量系統、熔點高密度聚乙烯 ("熔點 HDPE") 管道解決方案、特別設計之處理廠產品、地工合成材料與水土保持產品。本公司之服務與能力可與客戶整合，並為其採購與採購功能之一部分。

本公司為控股公司，間接擁有 Core & Main LP 之權益，透過其在 Core & Main Holdings, LP ("Holdings") 之權益。Core & Main 之主要資產為其直接與間接在 Holdings 之權益與與此權益相關之遞延所得稅資產。本年度報告表10-K 所包含之合併財務資訊，包括隨附之審計合併財務報表，包含 Holdings 及其子公司之合併財務資訊。Holdings 之有限合夥人權益 ("Partner Interests") 未由本公司持有者，於簡化合併財務報表中列為非控制性權益。

本公司會計年度為一個 52 或 53 週的期間，於 1 月 31 日附近之星期日結束。會計年度內之季度為 13 週期間，除非會計年度包含 53 週，則第四季為 14 週期間。會計年度於 2026 年 2 月 1 日結束 ("會計 2025") 包含 52 週，會計年度於 2025 年 2 月 2 日結束 ("會計 2024") 包含 53 週，會計年度於 2024 年 1 月 28 日結束 ("會計 2023") 包含 52 週。下一個會計年度於 2027 年 1 月 31 日結束 ("會計 2026") 將包含 52 週。
2025 年 12 月 1 日，本公司董事會批准將本公司股票回購計畫 ("回購計畫") 增加 5 億美元，使總授權金額達到 10 億美元。根據回購計畫購回之股票立即註銷，並計入股東權益之減少。在會計 2025 年度，本公司透過公開市場交易購回 3,173,594 股 A 級普通股，總計 1.55 億美元。
2024 年 2 月 9 日，Core & Main LP 修改了高利貸信用貸款協議 (如在本年度報告表10-K 其他部分所包含之審計合併財務報表之附註 6 所定義) 的條款，以將到期日從 2026 年 7 月 27 日延長至 2029 年 2 月 9 日。

2024 年 2 月 9 日，Core & Main LP 籤訂了一筆 7.5 億美元之高級定期貸款，該貸款於 2031 年 2 月 9 日到期 ("2031 高級定期貸款")。該 2031 高級定期貸款之資金用於，除其他事項外，(a) 償還高級信用貸款協議下所有未償還貸款，(b) 投資於內生成長與生產力計畫、併購、股票回購或其他與 Core & Main 資本配置策略一致之計畫，以及 (c) 支付相關費用、 premiums 及費用。
2024 年 2 月 12 日，Core & Main LP 籤訂了一筆利率交換協議，起始本金金額為 7.5 億美元，於 2026 年 7 月 27 日增加至 15 億美元，並於 2028 年 7 月 27 日到期。此工具旨在減少本公司在高級定期貸款下對變動利率之風險暴露。
於 2024 年 5 月 21 日，Core & Main LP 修改了 15 億美元高級定期貸款（經修改後，稱為「2028 年高級定期貸款」）的條款，以將適用利率從 2.60% 減少至 2.00%。
於 2024 年 12 月 17 日，Core & Main LP 修改了 2031 年高級定期貸款的條款，以將本金餘額增加 2 億美元至 944 億美元，並以所得資金償還 2028 年高級定期貸款下的現有貸款。此外，此修改將適用利率從 2.25% 減少至 2.00%。
請參閱本年度報告 10-K 其他處所附之審計過的合併財務報表附註 6，以取得關於高級週轉信貸協議、2028 年高級定期貸款、2031 年高級定期貸款及利率期貨之條款修改的進一步討論。
於 2024 年 6 月 12 日，本公司董事會批准根據回購計畫，回購本公司 Class A 普通股最高 5 億美元。在 2024 財年，本公司透過公開市場交易，回購 Class A 普通股 3,974,820 股，總計 176 億美元。
在 2023 財年，本公司從與 CD&R 有關聯的某些出售股東處回購總計 45,000,000 股 Class A 普通股及合夥權，總計支付 1,344 億美元。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 其他處所附之審計過的合併財務報表附註 1，以取得關於 2023 財年完成之股份回購交易的進一步討論。
在 2023 財年，與 CD&R 有關聯的某些股東將 43,406,925 股合夥權及 Class B 普通股（已註銷）交換為相應數量的 Class A 普通股。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們過去曾因美國住宅及非住宅建設市場的下滑與波動而受到負面影響，且可能持續受到此影響，導致淨銷售額減少。
我們的業務及我們產品與服務的市場通常受到地方政府基礎建設支出減緩的影響，可能導致淨銷售額減少。
我們可能透過競標程序失去客戶給競爭對手。
我們的產品成本會受到價格波動的影響。
我們面臨存貨管理的風險。存貨不足可能導致銷售機會喪失或收入延遲，而存貨過多可能對我們的毛利率造成負面影響。
收購及其他戰略交易涉及多種內在風險，任何一種風險都可能導致預期的效益無法實現。
我公司所屬產業及營運之市場為分散且高度競爭，增加之競爭壓力，包括合併壓力，可能對我公司業務造成不利影響。
供應鏈中 distributors 產品之替代方案之發展，可能導致我公司淨銷售額與營運結果之減少，並限制我公司拓展業務之能力。
我公司可能無法聘請、聘僱及留任關鍵人員，包括銷售代表、合格之分行、區及區域經理及高階管理人員。
供應商條款之變更可能對我公司收入及毛利率造成不利影響。
我公司營運結果對貨運之可得性相當敏感。
我公司可能無法識別新產品與新產品線，並將其整合至我公司之流通網路，此可能對我公司競爭能力造成不利影響。
公共衛生危機可能對我公司業務或財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我公司可能因遵守環境、健康與安全法規或許可制度，或因履行任何根據這些法規或許可制度所施加之責任或義務而產生重大成本。
本公司受規範及規範變更之影響，因聯邦、州或地方規範之變更，本公司營運成本可能增加。
若本公司之製造服務遭遇困難或中斷，可能延誤產品產出，並損害與客戶之關係。
本公司受與產品分銷及製造相關之安全及勞動風險影響。
本公司及第三方服務提供者資訊科技系統之運作中斷，或本公司或客戶之機密資訊遭竊取或未經授權使用，可能對本公司造成影響。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮下列所列之因素，並配合本年度10-K表報表中所載之其他資訊。這些風險因素對理解本年度10-K表報表之內容及其他報告內容至關重要。若其中一個或多個風險因素實現，可能會對本公司之營運、流動性或財務狀況、營業成果及/或現金流造成重大影響。本公司之聲譽、營運、財務狀況、營業成果及現金流均面臨各種風險。下列所列之風險與不確定性並非唯一影響本公司之因素。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司目前認為不重要，亦可能對本公司之聲譽、財務狀況、營業成果及現金流造成不利影響。
下列為您應仔細考慮之主要風險因素非窮盡性總結，若實現，可能會對本公司之營運、流動性或財務狀況、營業成果及/或現金流造成重大影響。這些風險在『風險因素』部分有更詳細說明。這些風險包括：
•美國住宅及非住宅建設市場之衰退、波動及週期性；
•地方政府基礎建設支出減緩及聯邦資金撥款延宕；
•本公司競標合約之能力；•本公司產品成本之價格波動（包括關稅之影響）；
•本公司有效管理存貨之能力，包括在供應鏈中斷期間。
